question: Which mantra is retained in the fivefold arrangement by qualified officiants?
premises: Īśāna is retained by the best twice-born.
inference: In the fivefold arrangement, the best twice-born exclude the Brahma mantras and retain Īśāna.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, in the fivefold arrangement, exclude the Brahma mantras and retain Īśāna.
